title: Muletto export guide
description: One provider's instructions for requesting a personal-data export. A guide is only finished once a human has BOTH walked the request flow and opened the resulting export in Muletto. See `confirmed`.

icon.description: Provider key mapping to an official brand mark (inline SVG) in the web app.

confirmed.description: Two independent checks, both done by hand. Neither may be filled in from documentation. A guide is finished only when both are set.

flow.description: Set once someone has walked the request flow start to finish and screenshotted each stage. Null until then.

on.description: The date the flow was walked, not the date the guide was edited.

import.description: Set once the real export from this provider has been opened in Muletto and the results checked against what the guide promises. Null until then.

export_size.description: How big the real export turned out to be. Feeds the size estimate shown to users.

findings.description: What the import got wrong, or confirmed.

difficulty.description: How painful the request is (dark patterns, friction).

wait_time.description: Human estimate of how long the export takes to arrive, e.g. "up to 7 days".

delivery.description: How the finished export reaches the user.

format.description: What the export is, e.g. "one or more .zip files".

data_types.description: Categories of data this export can contain.

url.description: The official page where the request is made.

image.description: Filename in apps/web/guides/img/, produced by tools/redact-screenshot.py. Never a raw capture.

uncertain.description: Set when this step is still written from documentation rather than from experience. The text says what specifically needs confirming. Rendered as a visible caveat, and listed in GUIDE-STATUS.md so it does not get forgotten.

muletto_support.description: What Muletto can do with this provider's export once the user has it.

adapter.description: Which parser/adapter handles this export, if any.
